# Live show

The waiting room, the player stage, the host console, the answer bars, the scoreboard and the recap.

[LiveLobby](#livelobby) · [LiveStage](#livestage) · [HostConsole](#hostconsole) · [AnswerDistribution](#answerdistribution) · [LiveScoreboard](#livescoreboard) · [EpisodeRecap](#episoderecap)

### LiveLobby

The waiting room before a show: its name, the time to go, who is here, and what to expect. It uses the dark studio look in both themes.

```ts
import { LiveLobby } from '@/contest/components/LiveLobby'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `episode` *(required)* | `Episode` |  | The show. |
| `questions` *(required)* | `Question[]` |  | The bank, for the length of the show. |
| `players` *(required)* | `string[]` |  | Names of the people who joined, newest last. |
| `joined` | `boolean` |  | Whether this person has joined. |
| `onJoin` | `() => void` |  | Shows a "Join the show" button when the person has not joined. |
| `now` | `() => number` |  | Replaces the clock of the countdown. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes. |

```tsx
<LiveLobby episode={episode} questions={bank} players={joined.map(nameOf)} joined={joined.includes(me)} onJoin={join} />
```

### LiveStage

What a player sees while the show runs: a countdown ring, the question, big answer tiles (colour, shape and letter), a "locked in" state, then the reveal with the points won, the streak and the scoreboard.

```ts
import { LiveStage } from '@/contest/components/LiveStage'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `state` *(required)* | `LiveState` |  | The live show now. |
| `ctx` *(required)* | `LiveContext` |  | The show, the questions and the keys the state machine needs. |
| `participantId` *(required)* | `string` |  | The person watching. |
| `now` *(required)* | `number` |  | The server's clock in milliseconds. Every countdown is worked out from it. |
| `onAnswer` *(required)* | `(value: AnswerValue) => void` |  | Called with the answer when the person picks it. |
| `nameOf` *(required)* | `(id: string) => string` |  | A readable name for the scoreboard. |
| `poll` | `ReactNode` |  | Shown during a poll slot, for example a `PollCard`. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes. |

```tsx
<LiveStage state={live} ctx={ctx} participantId={me} now={now} nameOf={nameOf} onAnswer={(value) => send({ type: 'answer', participantId: me, value })} />
```

- Questions with up to four options show as tiles; other types use the ordinary answer input and a "Lock in" button.
- A person who joined during a question waits for the next one. The first answer counts and cannot be changed.
- Timers come from the server's clock, so a reloaded page shows the same second as everyone else.

### HostConsole

The host's control desk. One big button always does the next sensible thing (start, lock, reveal, next), a ring shows the time, a meter shows how many players answered, and bars show how the room splits. Space does the main thing, R reveals at once, P pauses.

```ts
import { HostConsole } from '@/contest/components/HostConsole'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `state` *(required)* | `LiveState` |  | The live show now. |
| `ctx` *(required)* | `LiveContext` |  | The show, the questions and the keys. |
| `now` *(required)* | `number` |  | The server's clock in milliseconds. |
| `onCommand` *(required)* | `(command: LiveCommand) => void` |  | Called with the command to send: start, lock, reveal, next, pause, resume, finish or close. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes. |

```tsx
<HostConsole state={live} ctx={ctx} now={now} onCommand={(c) => void send(c)} />
```

- The keys work anywhere on the page except in a text box.

### AnswerDistribution

How the room answered: a bar per option with its shape and letter, the count and the share. The right options are marked after the reveal. TILE_SHAPES are the shapes that go with the tile colours.

```ts
import { AnswerDistribution } from '@/contest/components/AnswerDistribution'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `options` *(required)* | `ChoiceOption[]` |  | The options, in order. |
| `counts` *(required)* | `Record<string, number>` |  | How many people picked each option, by id. |
| `correct` | `string[]` |  | The right options. They are marked once `reveal` is on. |
| `reveal` | `boolean` |  | Marks the right options and dims the others. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes. |

```tsx
<AnswerDistribution options={q.options} counts={optionCounts(live, q.id)} correct={key.correct} reveal={phase === 'revealed'} />
```

### LiveScoreboard

The scoreboard of a live show: place, name, points, the points just won, and a flame for a streak. Rows slide when the order changes.

```ts
import { LiveScoreboard } from '@/contest/components/LiveScoreboard'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rows` *(required)* | `LiveRow[]` |  | The ranking, best first. See `liveRanking`. |
| `limit` | `number` | `5` | Shows the best N. The highlighted person is always shown. |
| `highlightId` | `string` |  | The person looking: marked, and shown even below the line. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes. |

```tsx
<LiveScoreboard rows={liveRanking(live, nameOf)} highlightId={me} />
```

### EpisodeRecap

How a finished show went: the podium, how many played, the average time to answer, and the easiest and hardest question.

```ts
import { EpisodeRecap } from '@/contest/components/EpisodeRecap'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `episode` *(required)* | `Episode` |  | A finished show with a `result`. |
| `questions` *(required)* | `Question[]` |  | The bank, for the question texts. |
| `nameOf` *(required)* | `(id: string) => string` |  | A readable name for a player. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes. |

```tsx
<EpisodeRecap episode={episode} questions={bank} nameOf={nameOf} />
```
